opportunities.name: Track a Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: On us.megabus.com, open Check my bus > Track my bus, switch to the Service Number tab, enter a service number, pick the matching route and click Find my bus.
steps: Click 'Check my bus' in the header
Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'
Select the matching route suggestion (e.g. origin city)

opportunities.name: Book tickets for a Resy special event
opportunities.description: On resy.com, open Special Events & Experiences for a city, pick an event, set the ticket count, choose the ticket option or time, and continue to Reserve Now.
steps: Open the Special Events & Experiences listing for the current city (Events filter or 'See more')
Select the number of tickets in the tickets dropdown
Click the ticket option's 'Book Now' or time-slot button
Review the 'Complete Your Reservation' dialog and click 'Reserve Now'

opportunities.name: Look up national parks by state on NPS
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use Find a Park > By State to open a state's parks page and open an info link (Current Conditions or Basic Information) for a specific park.
steps: Click the 'Find a Park' By State dropdown on the homepage
On the state page, find the target park
Click its info link (Current Conditions / Basic Information / Alerts)
